documents.title: Generative AI Use in Education
documents.quality_note: University guidelines and principles for GenAI in teaching and learning, covering instructors, students, academic honesty and privacy.

notes: Searches found no Hajim School or Computer Science department AI policy (only course-level pages, which are deferred). The rochester.edu/communications AI guidelines are for marketing teams and were not collected. A smartcatalogiq 'Artificial Intelligence Policy' hit belongs to Rochester Christian University (a different institution) and was excluded. The research-use committee page (rochester.edu/university-research/ai-research-committee/) was not collected.
